nodes.description: Initial OER performance evaluation in three-electrode system
nodes.source_text: The NiFe oxide precatalyst, when tested directly, exhibited an initial overpotential of 307 mV to achieve a current density of 50 mA/cm2 (η50) and a mass activity of 40.0 A/g at 300 mV overpotential... The measured Tafel slopes are 50.4 mV/dec for the initial NiFe oxide.

In contrast, the NiFeOOH catalyst, prepared via the AC activation process, demonstrated a lower η50 of 288 mV and a significantly higher mass activity of 72.8 A/g at 300 mV overpotential... Tafel slopes are... 42.8 mV/dec for AC-prepared NiFeOOH.

Tafel slopes are... 30.3 mV/dec for post-RPP NiFeOOH... pronounced increase in O2 production accompanying the rise in current density upon RPP treatment.

nodes.description: Extended OER stability with and without intermittent RPP strategy
nodes.source_text: alternating the anode potential between 1.51 VRHE for 1 h for OER and 0 VRHE for 1 min as RPP. The results show that the current density gradually increased by 84% during the first 60 h... stabilized... for the subsequent 450 h. In contrast, the OER operation without RPP exhibited a continuous decline in current density of 67% over 500 h.
